Robo.Heading: Robo Scrollbar
Robo.Paragraph: Apple-style scrollbars rasterized natively in C++. Drag the thumb, click the track to jump, and hover to see the interactive states.
Try it before scrolling down: drag a thumb, or click a track to jump. Both orientations are live here.
With contentSize=800 and viewportSize=200 the thumb occupies 25% of the 240px track. Drag it or click anywhere on the track.
Orientation="horizontal" lays the track along the x-axis. Here the thumb ratio is set explicitly to 35%.
Robo.H2: 3. Overlay scrollbar pinned to a panel edge
Robo.Paragraph: A scrollbar placed inside a Position container and anchored to the top-right corner, the classic overlay pattern used by long scroll areas.

Position.Paragraph: Scrollable content lives here. The overlay thumb floats above the panel on the right edge.

Robo.Paragraph: The scrollbar participates in flex layout like any other child, so it lines up with headings and buttons on the same row.
Robo.H2: 5. Thick track with a colored thumb
Robo.Paragraph: Thickness, corner radius, and every color are configurable, so the control matches any dark or light surface.
